name.en: The Deep Forest of the White Crow
name.ja: <ruby>白<rt>はく</rt></ruby><ruby>鴉<rt>あ</rt></ruby>の<ruby>深<rt>ふか</rt></ruby>き<ruby>森<rt>もり</rt></ruby>

text.en: When this card is activated: You can add 1 "White Crow" monster from your Deck to your hand. "White Crow" Monster Cards you control cannot be destroyed by card effects. During your End Phase: You can Set 1 "White Crow" Trap from your Deck or GY. You can only use this effect of "The Deep Forest of the White Crow" once per turn. You can only activate 1 "The Deep Forest of the White Crow" per turn.
